lines.en: woods... I can't go back.
The smell of fallen leaves — like autumn.
My knees creak. Slow going.

lines.zh: 我这身骨头，是秋天的颜色。
lines.en: These bones of mine wear autumn colors.

lines.zh: 我掉的箭，都是秋天色的。
lines.en: The arrows I drop are the color of autumn.
Mud in every joint.

lines.zh: 秋天的骨头，走起来沙沙。
lines.en: Autumn bones rattle as they walk.
One step... another step.
Don't step on the red leaves — they crackle.
Too bright by day — even my bones.
Which way? All leaves look alike.

lines.zh: 秋天的森林，我的骨头也是褐色。
lines.en: Autumn woods; my bones are brown too.
Quiet... far too quiet.
Wind drops a leaf. I don't move.
Wind passes through my ribs for me.
I can stand here forever.

lines.zh: 我的骨头，是秋天的颜色。
lines.en: My bones are autumn-colored.

lines.zh: 秋天的森林，我的骨头也黄了。
lines.en: Autumn forest, and even my bones turned yellow.
A moment more, and my bones wake.
Dawn is fine; I never warm.
Day breaks; the red leaves sting.
Who I wait for — I forget.
The living always look around.

lines.zh: 我的骨头上还挂着落叶。
lines.en: Leaves still hang on my bones.
Your eyes are still wet.
I hear your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 你的白气，在秋里很显眼。
lines.en: Your breath stands out in the autumn air.

lines.zh: 这张脸，你很久以前见过。
lines.en: You've seen this face long ago.

lines.zh: 我的骨头是秋叶的颜色。
lines.en: My bones are colored like autumn leaves.
Closer. My sockets hold no eyes.
Someone stands behind you.
Rust-orange shadow. You look fine too.
Pain — even without flesh.
Click. My shoulder blade slipped.

lines.zh: 秋天的叶子，从我肋骨间穿过。
lines.en: Autumn leaves pass between my ribs.
Pain — so I still feel pain.
Strong enough to shatter bone.
Again. I have bones to spare.
This body stands on bone alone.
Stop — my bones will scatter.
Another rib gone.
Don't touch the wound.
One bone, and I'll remember the way.
Under the rotten leaves, something familiar.
Your hand. Keep it away.
Hungry... a word I remember well.
This hunger has no bottom.
Save me a piece. Just one.
That meat steams. Don't hide it.
Blood — from your sleeve.
The hand that draws the bow can't hold anything.
I shouldn't have reached for it.
You smell of sweat. Not kin.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨，已经支起来了。
lines.en: My ribs are already poking out.
Your heartbeat struck me.
Don't push — my ribs come loose.
My shoulder fell. Kick it back.
Sorry. I forget my own weight.

lines.zh: 半边架子都被你撞歪了。
lines.en: Half my frame is knocked askew.
Don't touch. I'm all rotten leaves.
A living shoulder is hard.
My knuckles clack on impact.
Are you cold? I have no skin.
Autumn ends. I remain.
I'd hold you, but I'd fall apart.

lines.zh: 秋天的骨头，比叶子还脆。
lines.en: Autumn bones are frailer than leaves.
These bones can't hold you.

lines.zh: 秋色的骨头，下辈子早点来。
lines.en: Autumn bones — I'll come earlier next life.

lines.zh: 你也躺下，我们就一样了。
lines.en: Lie down too, and we'd match.
Don't look. I'm not whole.
Fallen leaves reach my knees.

lines.zh: 落叶落在我骨头上，暖不了。
lines.en: Fallen leaves on my bones don't warm me.
Maple-toned bones. What's to pick up?
This arrow can fly again.
Hold it. Don't drop it.
One bone picked, one more.

lines.zh: 秋天的森林里，我的骨头也是褐的。
lines.en: In autumn woods, my bones are brown too.

lines.zh: 口袋破了个洞，箭都漏了。
lines.en: A hole in my pocket — arrows slipped out.
Pick it up. Steady.
For me? Then I'll take it.

lines.zh: 这枚扣子，我生前也缝过。
lines.en: I sewed a button like this, alive.
Autumn's gift. I'll take it.
Take it slow. I needn't breathe.

lines.zh: 枯叶一响，我就知道是你。
lines.en: A dry leaf crackles, and I know it's you.
This wood — you shouldn't enter.
Still beating. Too loud.
Living one, don't tread my leaf pile.
Found you, under the autumn leaves.
Don't fear. Just one arrow.
You. Stand still.
My arrow is faster than my legs.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是秋天的颜色。
lines.en: My face is the colour of autumn.
Run along — I'll wait right here.

lines.zh: 秋色的骨头，踩上去会响。
lines.en: Autumn bones crunch underfoot.
Don't turn. Too late.
The life on you is too new.

lines.zh: 秋天的颜色，披在我骨头上。
lines.en: Autumn colors on my bones.
Stop. My arrow's not nocked.
Pant. I never need air.

lines.zh: 我的箭，是秋天剩下的那支。
lines.en: My arrow is the one autumn left me.

lines.zh: 红叶落你肩上，我看见了。
lines.en: A red leaf lands on you. I saw.
Autumn leaves settle on my bones.
Don't run. The arrow's drawn.
Arrow snapped? I still have teeth.
Slow down; I aim true.
Running loosens my joints.

lines.zh: 秋天的森林，我的骨头是橙的。
lines.en: In autumn woods my bones turn orange.

lines.zh: 落叶这片林地，我熟得很。
lines.en: I know these leaf-strewn woods well.

lines.zh: 我这副秋色的骨头，专在林子里等。
lines.en: These autumn bones wait in the woods.
Leaves ahead. No path.

lines.zh: 我从秋天追到现在，别停。
lines.en: I have chased since autumn; do not stop.
Arrow nocked. Just aiming.
Autumn came, and you have already lost.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，落叶盖住脚印。
lines.en: You will not escape; leaves hide the prints.
Drawing in this wood, leaves block my sight.
Don't dodge. My aim is poor.

lines.zh: 你看，我这把骨头还撑得住。
lines.en: See, these old bones still hold up.
This blow hoarded all autumn.
Bones are brittle. So is your scream.
Bone against bone. Does it hurt?
One step back. Just right.
My arrows still carry dead leaves.

lines.zh: 箭袋空了，只剩这把骨弓。
lines.en: My quiver's empty; only the bone bow is left.
This time, I finally caught it.

lines.zh: 落叶堆底下，我铺好了箭。
lines.en: Under the leaf litter I laid my arrows.
The string sounds. The forest goes quiet.

lines.zh: 这枝箭，是拿我的骨头削的。
lines.en: This arrow was whittled from my own bone.
Lifting my arm — joints grind.
A joint in my finger bones came loose.
Sorry. My hand is quicker than my mind.
My bone hand comes down fast.

lines.zh: 落叶埋了我一整个秋天。
lines.en: Fallen leaves buried me all autumn.

lines.zh: 秋天把我从土里翻出来。
lines.en: Autumn turned me out of the soil.

lines.zh: 林子里的人气，我先避开。
lines.en: In the forest, I avoid the smell of the living.
First thing on waking: find arrows.
The leaves turned red. Time to rise.
Dawnlight through my ribs — too bright.
Stand. Knees crack first.
This body again.
I rose out of the leaf litter.
In the leaf pile, my arrow sounds first.
No torch. The leaves would burn.
Autumn comes, and I rise again.
Fallen leaves cannot warm me.

lines.zh: 这片林子的秋天，我认得。
lines.en: This forest's autumn — I know it.
Fire! I hate fire.
I fell apart.
Water seeps between my bones.
Blown apart. I look for my fingers.
Stuck in. Can't pull it out.
That smell burns my bones.
Hungry — autumn can't fill me.
The sky strikes me.

lines.zh: 秋天的骨头，颜色像落叶。
lines.en: Autumn bones, the color of fallen leaves.
